lines.beaver_en: Minsu, I heard you're running late. What happened?
lines.en: I took an express bus, but the traffic is terrible.
It's a holiday, so there are lots of cars. There was an accident too.

lines.beaver_en: That's bad. What kind of accident?
lines.learner: 회색 트럭이 넘어져서 길을 막고 있어.
lines.en: A gray truck tipped over and is blocking the road.
lines.roman: hoesaek teureogi neomeojyeoseo gireul makgo isseo.

lines.beaver_en: Then when do you think you'll arrive?
lines.learner: 한 시간은 더 걸릴 테니까 먼저 가 있어.
lines.en: It'll take at least another hour, so go ahead first.
lines.roman: han siganeun deo geollil tenikka meonjeo ga isseo.

lines.beaver: 버스에서 내려서 열차를 타는 건 어때?
lines.beaver_en: How about getting off the bus and taking a train?
lines.beaver_roman: beoseueseo naeryeoseo yeolchareul taneun geon eottae?
lines.learner: 좋아. 다음 정류장이 역 근처일 테니까 거기서 내릴게.
lines.en: Good. The next stop must be near the station, so I'll get off there.
lines.roman: joa. daeum jeongnyujangi yeok geuncheoil tenikka geogiseo naerilge.

lines.beaver_en: But that'll cost a lot in fares.
lines.en: The fare is fine. The train is more convenient.

lines.beaver: 그럼 내가 차로 역에 데리러 갈게.
lines.beaver_en: Then I'll drive to the station to pick you up.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom naega charo yeoge derireo galge.
lines.learner: 역은 주차가 힘들 테니까 그냥 기다려.
lines.en: Parking at the station will be hard, so just wait.
lines.roman: yeogeun juchaga himdeul tenikka geunyang gidaryeo.

lines.beaver_en: Then should I wait at the café in front of the station?
lines.learner: 응, 표를 사면 바로 문자 보낼게.
lines.en: Yes, I'll text you as soon as I buy a ticket.
lines.roman: eung, pyoreul samyeon baro munja bonaelge.

lines.beaver: 알았어. 몇 시 열차일 것 같아?
lines.beaver_en: Okay. What time train do you think it'll be?
lines.beaver_roman: arasseo. myeot si yeolchail geot gata?
lines.learner: 두 시 열차가 있을 테니까 세 시에 만나자.
lines.en: There should be a two o'clock train, so let's meet at three.
lines.roman: du si yeolchaga isseul tenikka se sie mannaja.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Get here safely. See you later!
lines.learner: 고마워. 늦어서 정말 미안해. 이따 봐!
lines.en: Thanks. I'm really sorry I'm late. See you later!
lines.roman: gomawo. neujeoseo jeongmal mianhae. itta bwa!
